# nd_fabric_aci (Data Source)

Datasource of the Fabric ACI for Nexus Dashboard.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nd_fabric_aci" "test_datasource_fabric_aci_1" {
  fabric_name = "apic1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `fabric_name` (String) The name that uniquely identifies the APIC cluster.

### Read-Only

- `hostname` (String) The IP address or hostname of the APIC cluster. Do not include the protocol (`http://` or `https://`) in the value.
- `last_update_message` (String) The last update message of the APIC cluster.
- `latitude` (Number) The latitude coordinate of the APIC cluster.
- `license_tier` (String) The license tier of the APIC cluster.
- `longitude` (Number) The longitude coordinate of the APIC cluster.
- `orchestration_status` (String) The status of the orchestration feature for the APIC cluster.
- `security_domain` (String) The name of the security domain for the APIC cluster.
- `state` (String) The state of the APIC cluster.
- `telemetry` (Attributes) Configures telemetry collection for the APIC cluster. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--telemetry))

<a id="nestedatt--telemetry"></a>
### Nested Schema for `telemetry`

Read-Only:

- `epg` (String) The APIC End Point Group (EPG) Distinguished Name (DN) used by `inband` telemetry.
- `network` (String) The network type for telemetry collection.
- `status` (String) The status of telemetry collection for the APIC cluster.
- `streaming_protocol` (String) The streaming protocol used for telemetry collection.
